Where Can Companies Find New Cyber Security Leads in 2025?

In 2025, the best places to find new cybersecurity leads include AI-powered intent data platforms, industry trade shows, LinkedIn prospecting, B2B marketplaces, MSP partnerships, and content-driven campaigns.

Top Lead Sources:

  • Cybersecurity Trade Shows & Webinars – RSA, Black Hat, DEF CON, Infosecurity Europe.
  • AI-Driven Intent Data Platforms – Predictive tools that show who’s researching cyber solutions.
  • B2B Marketplaces & Directories – Platforms connecting IT buyers and vendors.
  • LinkedIn Outreach & Targeted Ads – Engage directly with CISOs and IT leaders.
  • Partnerships with Managed Service Providers (MSPs) – Co-market with trusted IT partners.
  • Content Marketing – Whitepapers, compliance reports, and thought leadership.

How to Get Cyber Security Leads in 2025 (Proven Strategies) 

1. Leverage Cybersecurity Events & Webinars 

Events remain one of the highest ROI channels in cybersecurity sales. In 2025, hybrid formats (in-person + virtual) dominate, giving you both physical presence and digital reach.

Example: At RSA or Black Hat, run a live demo, capture QR-based leads, and follow up with personalized outreach

2. Use AI-Powered Intent Data & Predictive Analytics 

Gone are the days of cold lists. With AI-driven lead generation, companies can track buying signals in real-time:

  • Google searches for “best endpoint protection 2025”
  • Job postings for cybersecurity engineers
  • Tech stack changes in CRMs  

AI then scores prospects based on likelihood to convert, so sales teams focus only on high-intent buyers.

3. Build Authority with Content Marketing

Decision-makers want trusted insights, not sales pitches. Publishing reports like “The 2025 Cyber Threat Landscape” or compliance guides builds authority while capturing leads through gated downloads.

Best content formats:

  • Whitepapers & compliance checklists
  • Cyber threat intelligence blogs
  • Webinars on zero-trust, cloud security, and ransomware prevention

4. LinkedIn & Social Selling 

LinkedIn remains the #1 channel for CISO and IT decision-maker engagement. In 2025, smart sellers use:

  • Thought leadership posts on cyber risk trends.
  • LinkedIn Ads targeting specific industries (finance, healthcare, government).
  • Direct InMail to connect with CISOs and CTOs.

5. Partner with Managed Service Providers (MSPs) 

MSPs already manage IT systems for SMBs and enterprises making them a trusted referral channel. Partnering with MSPs allows cybersecurity vendors to:

  • Bundle solutions
  • Gain credibility
  • Expand reach into SMBs and mid-market companies

6. Run Account-Based Marketing (ABM) Campaigns

In 2025, ABM + AI personalization is the winning formula. Instead of generic campaigns, ABM tailors' outreach to specific target accounts.

Best ABM tactics:

  • Personalized email campaigns for CISOs.
  • Customized landing pages for top accounts.
  • Nurture sequences triggered by intent data.

Trends in Cybersecurity Lead Generation for 2025 

  • AI-Powered Personalization – Outreach tailored to individual buyer behavior.
  • Privacy-First Marketing – Compliance with GDPR, CCPA, and the EU AI Act.
  • Cybersecurity-as-a-Service (CSaaS) – Growing demand from SMBs.
  • Conversational AI & Chatbots – Real-time lead capture on websites.

Challenges to Watch Out For 

  • Lengthy enterprise buying cycles.
  • Intense vendor competition.
  • Stricter compliance (SOC 2, GDPR, AI regulations).
  • Balancing automation with human credibility.
